notes: Selection: FinePDFs whole; FineWeb-2 and HPLT 2.0 paragraphs by ascending seeded rank (seed 20261018) below rank_cut until about 0.5B estimated tokens.
Filters per paragraph, in order: in MADLAD-400 fil (clean or noisy) removed; exact duplicates removed (earlier source wins); held-out overlap removed (D28 item 6).
98 of 10,792,835 segments are over 127 tokens: single whitespace-free strings that cannot be trimmed by words; the collator truncates them.

Build 1 on 2026-10-18 was discarded before registration: 21 duplicate row ids (FinePDFs splits one PDF into rows with the same doc id) and 3,862 segments over 127 tokens; fixed in the builder commit above.
